title: Velocity Reconstruction from Flow-Induced Magnetic Fields
summary: We study the inverse problem of reconstructing an incompressible velocity field $\boldsymbol{v}$ from observations of the induced magnetic field $\boldsymbol{b}$. In the presence of a strong, constant background field $\mathbf{F}$, the evolution of the magnetic perturbation $\boldsymbol{b}$ is governed by the linearized induction equation. We analyze the system on both the entire space $Ω= \mathbb{R}^d$ and a periodic domain $Ω= \prod_{i=1}^d [0, L_i)$, which models a homogeneous medium with side lengths $L_i > 0$.
